title: Meet the young authors! A literacy program inspires kids in South Africa
summary: South Africa is working to overcome a children's literacy crisis. In one Johannesburg township, a reading club is instilling a love of books in kids — and inspiring them to become authors.
content: From Gomora to the World. Stories from Alex, a new book of short stories written by kids who are part of the "Read Alex" literacy program in Johannesburg. Participants in weekly classes wrote stories drawing on their own lives.'/> South Africa is working to overcome a children's literacy crisis. In one Johannesburg township, a reading club is instilling a love of books in kids — and inspiring them to become authors. (Image credit: Madalene Cronje for NPR)

title: Medicare looks a bit different in 2027, so don't miss open enrollment
summary: Open enrollment for Medicare runs through Dec. 7, and there are a few different pitfalls people should watch out for this year. Your drug plan or Medicare Advantage plan could be changing a lot.
